problem: A bakery sells cupcakes for $2 each and cookies for $3 each. If Sarah buys 4 cupcakes and 5 cookies, then spends an additional $10 on other treats, how much did she spend in total? How many items did she buy?
During a bake sale, Lisa sold 12 cakes for $15 each, 30 cupcakes for $3 each, and 10 loaves of bread for $8 each. If she had to spend $50 on ingredients, how much profit did she make?
Liam has 3/4 of a chocolate bar. He gives 1/2 of what he has to his friend. How much of the chocolate bar does Liam have left?

You have three activities planned for the weekend. The first activity is a hike that lasts 180 minutes. The second activity is a picnic that lasts 240 minutes. The third activity is a movie that lasts 120 minutes. How many hours do you spend on all three activities combined?

Sarah is organizing a school event. She needs to buy 12 boxes of cupcakes. Each box contains 15 cupcakes. She also wants to buy 10 boxes of cookies, with each box containing 20 cookies. If she plans to serve 3 cupcakes and 2 cookies per student and expects 30 students, how many extra cupcakes and cookies will she have after the event?

Tom read 20 pages of a novel on Wednesday and 35 pages on Thursday. On Friday, he decided to read twice as many pages as he did on Wednesday. How many pages did Tom read in total over these three days?

A school is printing a new textbook that has 150 pages. They plan to print 8 copies for each of the 5 classes. If each class has 4 students, how many pages will be printed in total? After distributing the textbooks, if each student reads 10 pages, how many pages will remain un-read across all classes?

Sofia plans to read a total of 300 pages over the next 15 days. In the first week, she reads 50 pages, and in the second week, she reads 70 pages. How many pages does she need to read each day for the remaining days to reach her goal?
Tom is writing a book. He wrote 20 pages in the first week and 15 pages in the second week. If he plans to write 10 pages each week for the next 3 weeks, how many pages will he have written in total?

Tom is making friendship bracelets. He uses a pattern of red, blue, and green beads. If he makes 5 bracelets and uses the same pattern for each, how many beads does he use if each bracelet requires 6 beads?
A store sells pencils for $2 each and erasers for $1 each. Emma buys 5 pencils and 3 erasers. Later, she returns 2 pencils and buys 1 more eraser. How much money did Emma spend in total?

You are having a pizza party with 4 friends. You order 5 pizzas. Each pizza has 10 slices. If each person eats 2 slices and you want to save 3 slices for later, how many slices will be left over after everyone has eaten?
Lily is making a fruit salad. She has 4 bananas, 3 oranges, and 2 apples. If she uses 1 banana and 1 orange, how many pieces of fruit does she have left?
